critical_code_review_comments: All 5 Batch 7 P1 features implemented correctly with proper validation and error handling

Menu Engineering: 4-quadrant classification (star/plowhorse/puzzle/dog) based on median CM × median popularity, CSV export working

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 220 completes Batch 7 (first 5 P1 keyless competitor-parity features). All 30 P0 features from Batches 1-6 remain working. Features tested: (1) Mid-stay Pulse Survey at /api/mid-stay/* - day 2+ survey with service recovery for low scores. (2) In-stay Folio PDF at /api/folio-live/* - running folio with implicit room charge fallback. (3) A/B Test Engine at /api/ab/* - experiments with deterministic hash-based assignment. Sidebar buttons: mid-stay-btn, folio-live-btn, ab-test-btn, pre-arrival-btn, menu-engineering-btn. Public page: /mid-stay/{invite_id} for guest survey submission.
